deskNote: Market breadth is today's first filter because consumer demand cues matter only if FMCG, autos and retail lenders confirm after the opening range. Track Nifty VWAP against 23,712.2; sentiment at -0.05 says the first range must prove direction. Tech breadth needs Nasdaq futures and USD/INR to align; treat exporter breadth as the tell, not the trade by itself. Let the first 15 minutes print, then trade only the side that holds VWAP with breadth behind it.
watchItems: Nasdaq and semiconductor futures into the cash open; use them as risk-appetite context, not an automatic Nifty IT call.
Watch Gift Nifty premium/discount into 9:15 AM, then Nifty VWAP and Bank Nifty breadth.
Brent direction before the Europe open and whether oil-import sensitivity hits India breadth.
onePageSummary:
Market Mood: NEUTRAL

Global Cues: S&P 500 +1.079%, Nasdaq 100 +1.662%, Dow Jones +1.308%, Nifty 50 +0.225%, Bank Nifty +0.273%, Nikkei 225 +3.438%, Hang Seng -0.371%, Shanghai Composite -0.341%, KOSPI +8.22%, Taiwan Weighted +3.367%, Straits Times -0.079%, ASX 200 +1.542%, US Dollar Index +0.097%, Brent Crude +1.019%, USD/INR -0.28%, Gold (COMEX) -0.214%, India VIX -2.82%, GIFT Nifty -0.38%

Narrative Themes:
- Negative Macro Impact: Australia’s unemployment rate climbed to the highest level since November 2021, suggesting the labor market is cooling faster than anticipated and prompting traders to dial back expectations for further interest-rate increases.
- Sector-Specific Pressure: India's core sector growth rose to 1.7% in April FY27, aided by steel, electricity and fertilizer recovery despite pressure from the West Asia crisis and energy supply disruptions
- Global Risk-Off Cue: Stock markets rally in early trade tracking positive trend in global peers easing oil prices
- Volatile Opening Bias: Benchmark indices closed marginally higher on Wednesday, led by gains in banking and auto shares, while IT and FMCG stocks capped advances. Analysts said Nifty remains range-bound with weak sentiment persisting below key resistance levels, despite easing volatility and selective buying interest across sectors.
- Global Earnings & Risk Appetite: A global reshuffling in stock-market hierarchy is underway. AI is propelling Taiwan and South Korea past a couple long-established Western countries.
- Sector-Specific Cushion: Nvidia Q1 Earnings: Net profit jumped to $58.3 billion, or $2.39 per share, during the first quarter of fiscal 2027, ending April 26, more than tripling from $18.8 billion in the year-earlier period. Excluding one-time items, Nvidia earned $1.76 per share.

Validated Trading Setups:
- No clean 1:2 RR setup is active yet; wait for fresh opening-range confirmation.
